name: Landsat8-Sentinel2 Fusion Dataset
description: We offered two datasets that can be potentially employed as standard datasets for Landsat8-Sentinel2 data fusion model assessment. The two datasets, ‘Hailar’ and ‘Dezhou’, contain 23 scenes and 24 scenes, respectively, and involve bands across visible, near infrared, and shortwave infrared ranges.
